result.title: MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction
result.summary: Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject's appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. With FLUX, it improves overall success on DreamOmni2 by 28.21 percentage points over the original backbone and achieves the highest overall score among the models evaluated on SconeEval.

AI.brief_summary: MAGPIE 面向多参考图生成，把目标构图表示为由 Blender 程序定义的可执行 3D 场景：编码 agent 将每个场景实例链接到对应参考图，比对几何与渲染视图和指令是否一致并据此改写程序，最后以代理渲染作为视觉计划来训练图像生成器。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作的核心是把难以直接检查的中间构思外化为可执行、可渲染核查并按差异修正的显式状态，与 LVR 中可检查的推理状态、视觉证据筛选和「看—改」循环可能有概念联系，可供核查其验证与修正机制；但任务是图像生成而非视觉推理，迁移性需判断。
